items.quote: In fact, we expect by 28 there'll be a glut of AHF supply. It'll be a buyer- more a buyer's market than a seller's market technically.

items.statement: Helium supply de-risked through strategic partnership with Sharjah Oxygen and swap mechanisms with multiple global suppliers
items.quote: Multiple. Sharjah Oxygen itself is a big company. Secondly we have worked with them very meaning our collaboration, our cooperation would extend further onwards.

items.statement: R32 manufacturing quota allocation pending government notification, all qualified applicants will receive quotas
items.quote: Till the government doesn't declare it everyone is hopeful, including the people who say they have.

items.statement: May consider equity dilution alongside debt for faster growth pace over next three years
items.quote: So keeping that in mind, we are now close to the idea that we might go for dilution onwards. Meaning I just gave my understanding of how our financial overview was from earlier.

items.statement: Currently no working capital issues, sufficient internal accruals, but may raise funds for faster project execution
items.quote: Currently we face no problem. We have sufficient to startup also we don't see any issues as such, but moving onwards like you need to understand how this business works.

items.statement: Focus on increasing contribution from higher value specialty gases and HFO blends while building on existing customer base
items.quote: The objective is to gradually increase the contribution from higher value products while building on the customer base and distribution network that we already have.

items.statement: ISRO tender negotiations at advanced stage, typical tender sizes 40,000-50,000 cubic meters, contract not yet finalized
items.quote: Usually the size of the tenders are like 40,000, 50,000 cubic meters of gas.

items.statement: India R32 manufacturing capacity 70-90,000 tons vs 20,000 tons domestic demand, export opportunity from China GWP quota reduction
items.quote: The manufacturing capacities are anywhere between 70 to 90,000 tons that's coming up. So your capacities are four times what is current requirement.

items.statement: R32 plant peak revenue potential 500-600 crores annually in FY28 at full utilization
items.quote: And for the full year utilization of this plant 500-600 crore in FY28 still holds.

items.statement: Helium prices expected to remain high for next 2-3 years due to global shortfall
items.quote: Price is definitely going to be up. The next two three years Helium outlook is shortfall and higher pricing.

items.statement: R32 plant timeline delayed from July to December 2026 due to funding delay from rights issue process
items.quote: So the funding came in late. Now basically you need a sizeable portion of the funding to start the work off. So what was originally planned to be December startup ended up being a March end startup.

items.statement: Same engineering team working on both Bhilwara and Mambattu projects, prioritized Bhilwara completion
items.quote: Basically the same team that were working at Bhilwara are also working here. So as a result, we want to speed up Bhilwara. We moved all the people out there.

items.statement: Mambattu facility redesigned from 5-tank to 12-tank structure with hydrocarbon, semiconductor and helium capabilities causing delay
items.quote: We enhanced it to a 12-tank structure with hydrocarbon capabilities with semiconductor and helium capabilities. So we we increased the whole thing by two and a half times.

items.statement: Targeting monthly net cash generation of Rs 3 crore by crossing Rs 10 crore monthly revenue while keeping cash outflow under Rs 7 crore
items.quote: my goal is next is to hit - cross 10 crore revenue and keep costs - the cash outflow under 7 cr so that we can hit this net cash at 3 cr per month

items.statement: July was the best month ever in company history with very high profitability; August continues the same strong trend
items.quote: August, like July, was great - our best month ever that we have experienced in our history - very, very profitable month and August continues to go in that direction

items.statement: Operating cash flow of Rs 4 crore in Q1 versus PAT of Rs 31 lakh; amortization of past capex ~Rs 42 lakh per quarter to continue for 2-3 years
items.quote: We did an Ebitda of 4.9 cr which is good but then we did after amortization which is for the all the stuff we have built in the past years - invested money in building courses also, in building technology so that non-cash charge is basically like it was there in the last quarter and in future also

items.statement: Investing outflow dropped to Rs 1.9 crore in Q1 from Rs 17.5 crore for full FY26; new build largely stopped, capex will not grow at same rate
items.quote: new build has largely stopped. So investing outflow was only 1.9 cr in Q1 versus 17.5 crore in the entire financial year last year

items.statement: Boot camps increased from 4 per month in Feb-Mar to 8 currently; targeting 10 per month next month with goal to double
items.quote: Now we are doing eight boot camps per month. Next month we are looking at doing 10 boot camps per month. And by the way one point of time it was down to four boot camps per month

items.statement: Lead costs dramatically reduced: 100-rupee qualified leads back to ~1,000 from peak; tripwire funnel cost down from 1,300 to 217; free boot camp registrations from 250 to 50-77 rupees
items.quote: you can see in September it was about 1,000 rupees in October - it doubled and then it was very high till March and by April it was down and now it is in the same level. Similarly there are 10 rupees kind of we call it a tripwire funnel. So it used to be like 1,300 rupees in January and February it was still like 900 or something and then now it is at 217

items.statement: Three revenue engines: boot camps ~Rs 4-5 cr/month collections, community consistently >Rs 1 cr/month, inside sales hit Rs 3.5 cr/month run rate
items.quote: boot camps - usually we are able to recover - booking is obviously much more but we're able to recover four to five cr let's say four cr every month to be very conservative. Some months we have got five also but some months let's say four - definitely community revenue has been consistently above 1 cr for the last four - five months and inside sales - last month we hit 3.5

items.statement: Inside sales revenue grew sequentially for last 4 months from Rs 2 cr to ~Rs 3.5 cr/month; new sales cohorts ramp up in 2-3 months
items.quote: the last four months we have had sequential growth. Every month we have added more and more revenue and now we are headed towards almost 4 cr per month. So it's already crossed three and a half cr per month

items.statement: Monthly net cash (collections minus costs) turned positive: April-May break-even at Rs 30 lakh, June Rs 1.8 cr, July >Rs 2 cr, August similar
items.quote: April and May became break even - a little positive at 30 lakh per month - I'm talking about our net cash right. So net cash how we calculate is the money that we received in our account - not the booking amount which is much larger but the sales amount which we actually received in account

items.statement: Zero debt; cash balance Rs 2.86 cr plus Rs 2.11 cr in quarter; Rs 7 cr+ undeployed IPO cash earmarked for acquisitions, seeking reclassification
items.quote: Part good thing is that our balance sheet is clean - we have this much cash 2.86 cr and up to 2.11 Cr in this quarter. Also we have 7 cr plus undeployed IPO cash which is meant for acquisitions

items.statement: US university partnership on hold; pre-approval done, final approval pending; plan to resume pursuit from Oct-Nov if Rs 2 cr monthly net cash sustained till September
items.quote: on the US university part, we had put it on hold - we had shared that in June also that right now we don't want to work on this but if we are able to keep this 2 cr going till September my goal is from October - November start pursuing the US university bit again and start working on with the regulators to get our approval

items.statement: Transitioning ~40 people in Gurgaon and ~30 in Indore to work-from-office for core teams; frontline remains remote; minimal cost increase of Rs 4-5 lakh/month
items.quote: we are going to work from office. Not all of us but about 40 people in Gurgaon and in Indore also 30 people - two offices where core teams will work from office because we have seen that a lot of things get much easier when you work from office and much harder when you work remotely

items.statement: AI-driven ad tech stack enables launching 50 ads/day vs 1 funnel/month previously; 4-person team replaced 20-person creative team; hourly AI monitoring of ad performance
items.quote: we are able to launch 50 ads a day sometimes, right? So we are able to build entire funnel that would take a month to build. Now we can build 50 of them in a day and this is AI-driven process and the final quality of the ads is way superior

items.statement: 25% of support tickets now self-solved via AI; certifications, refunds, e-KYC fully automated; support headcount not growing despite student growth
items.quote: now 25% of our support tickets are not just getting created, they are being solved. So we are continuously tracking where the tickets are more and we build self-service mechanisms in our support hub

items.statement: Bottleneck is training enough boot camp leaders and scaling sales team disciplinedly without operational hiccups; currently using only 50% of leads due to capacity constraints
items.quote: now we are effectively using only 50% of the leads and on the other hand we have a scope to increase the number of boot camps but we will need more boot camp leaders so we have Abhyuday doing boot camps, we have some few good very good leaders we have Nidhi, Sagar, Jasjit - now we need more of them so we are training them in house and slowly we will be able to - goal would be to double the number

items.statement: Target to cross 10 crore monthly revenue and keep cash outflow under 7 crore to achieve 3 crore net cash per month within next six months
items.quote: Biggest list item is hitting 10 Cr - I mean in the next and this is not for the whole year but in the next six months definitely do 10 cr revenue and with a cost of around 7 cr and stay at that level.

items.statement: Plan to restart US university pursuit and regulator approvals from October-November if 2 crore monthly cash flow sustained till September
items.quote: if we are able to keep this 2 cr going till September my goal is from October - November start pursuing the US university bit again and start working on with the regulators to get our approval.

items.statement: EBITDA margin will improve significantly in current quarter as sales and marketing investments from previous quarter drive growth
items.quote: So EBITDA is looking bad but in the current quarter your EBITDA will suddenly look way better right? So it will not be the new normal. You will see much better going forward.

items.statement: Expect 3 crore net cash generation this quarter with revenue upwards of 24 crore and cost outflow between 18-20 crore
items.value: 3 cr net cash, 24-25 cr revenue, 18-20 cr cost
items.quote: So like I said we did a 2.3 Cr net cash - sorry like it may not be 2.3 but 2.2 whatever something like that. Let's say 2. So if my revenue is around 8 like my revenue should land somewhere upwards of 24 cr maybe 24 maybe 25 maybe a little more so that is one - that is on the revenue part and then when I'm looking at my cost, cost is around somewhere between 18 and 19 crores maybe 20 cr max not mor

items.statement: Continuing to invest 50-70 lakhs per month in capex for content and technology development
items.quote: So we are still investing like half a cr - 70 lakhs per month in capex right so we have not stopped it so that is enough for us to keep competitive and we are way ahead of any competition.

items.statement: Free registration lead cost reduced from 120 rupees to 40-70 rupees per lead; CAC improved significantly
items.quote: My free registrations used to come at about 120 per lead and today they are at 50 rupees per lead, 40 rupees, 70 rupees per lead so it is even better than that time. CAC has really improved. Last month CAC was incredible.

items.statement: Monthly ad spend stable at 1.6-1.8 crore; people cost around 3 crore; software cost 50 lakhs to 1 crore
items.value: ad spend 1.6-1.8 cr, people cost ~3 cr, software 50L-1cr
items.quote: I can tell you my ad cost is around 2 cr per - it has been stable at 1.8 - 1.62 somewhere in between. People cost is around 3 cr I think - software cost somewhere between 50 lakh to 1 cr.

items.statement: Cash in bank around 9-10 crore; added 2-2.5 crore in recent quarter
items.quote: End of today I cannot say but it's around 9 - 10 cr cash in bank somewhere around somewhere between 9 and 10 cr we added now in that quarter also we added two and two something cr we added.

items.statement: No plans to raise funds in next year as internal cash flows sufficient for distribution scaling
items.quote: No because see we are currently accumulating cash and what we need - we don't need to build new things. We built a lot of new things. Our only thing is to build distribution and is it true that if I raise 10 cr now or 20 cr or 50 cr can I build my distribution faster? No, that is not the problem. Cash is not the problem in growth.

items.statement: No buyback planned; promoters intend to buy shares when trading window opens
items.quote: No absolutely not - these are not things I want to think about. So right now I want to think about how do you grow the business? If I have 40 - 50 crores of cash sitting in the bank someday then I will think - right now this is not the time.

items.statement: Two competitors shut down including a billion-dollar funded company; no competitive headwinds faced
items.quote: Since we have fixed our ads, two of our competitors shut down. One of them is a huge funded billion dollar valuation company which exited legal education. Because if you look at what we are offering there is nobody who's even close to any of these value propositions so that is not the issue.

items.statement: LawSikho revenue share grew from 25% to 45% last month (55-45 split with Skill Arbitrage) due to restarting law boot camps
items.quote: I can tell you for the month it is 55-45. So, LawSikho has grown back up again in a big way. And earlier it was around 25%, now last month it was 45% of the revenue but month on month - we haven't prepared it.

items.statement: LawSikho courses more profitable than Skill Arbitrage courses
items.quote: LawSikho courses are more profitable.

items.statement: Hired strong technology, automation and systems talent in last three months; planning 70-person office in Indore with 60% in sales
items.quote: But yeah like we had some fabulous hires in the last three months. People who are making a huge difference mostly on technology, on automation and systems - very huge very very good hires.

items.statement: Sales team scaling carefully with focus on management bandwidth and training to avoid past mistakes of over-hiring without management capacity
items.quote: One mistake that we did in the past was that we thought that okay look now we are able to train callers, right? So we were like let's scale it up. We thought if we can train not 30, we can train 80 people also but where the problem happens is what happens when all of all 80 of them are here? Who will manage them?

items.statement: Opening physical sales office in Indore for 30 people (20 sales); Gurgaon office for 40+ non-sales roles; remote sales challenging for consistency and motivation
items.quote: We have been able to crack it but would we want to keep doing it when we have 500 or thousand people? No. Now we would also want to have a physical sales team. That is why we are opening an office here. We are building a physical sales team also because we have realized and we have done this on a small basis previously also we had some part of it and we had achieved good success.

items.statement: US university pre-approval done, final approval pending; Arizona approval takes 1-2 months once applied
items.quote: Pre-approval was done, the final approval was pending and we can start working on that again - this is my plan.

items.statement: Key risks: bad hires in critical roles and ad cost ballooning post-October as seen in past
items.quote: One is that bad hires in important places is a big risk. Second is that our ad cost ballooning like it did in the past after October that is also a risk. These two things we don't have to allow to happen.

items.statement: Unit economics and net cash positivity are primary risk focus areas; everything else is subset of this
items.quote: Well I'll tell from the finance standpoint what are the risk areas which we are keeping and quite frankly I'll say unit economics. I mean there's a difference between investing in growth and keeping a very close eye on our unit economics and I think what we are focusing on very extensively now with a very clear north star metrics of being net cash positive - that is something that we are keeping a

items.statement: Monthly course sales (cash collections) reached 8.8 crore last month, up from 6-7 crore months earlier
items.quote: So course sales which actually hit the account not booking. So last month we did 8.8 cr, previous month we did I mean I think around 8 somewhere - 8.3 or something. Before that also was around that only 8 something or 8 maybe slightly less than 8 - that was in June and before that we were doing something like seven, some months six.

items.statement: IPO funds held in bonds and mutual funds; no debt mentioned
items.quote: These are mostly these are all most of them are in investment in bonds and mutual funds.

items.statement: Amortization of 4-4.5 crore per quarter expected to continue for next 2-3 years as heavy capex deployment completed
items.quote: Four - four and a half crores kind of number will continue for next year two to three years.

items.statement: Eligible for mainboard listing from January; leaning towards listing but evaluating timing based on stock price improvement
items.quote: One advice is that the moment you become eligible, go and get listed - which is January and anyway we have moved to quarterly reports and everything so it won't be such a big difference. Then some people have said no this is a thing that you should properly think through - let your numbers improve let your stock price improve and then you go into mainboard. So I don't know what is the right thing

items.statement: No active international sales; some solicitor qualification and Canadian bar exam revenue from Gulf/neighborhood countries via UK entity; US sales to restart after university approval
items.quote: International sales status we are not doing any international sales. We are fully in India. Once we set up the US university will chase US sales again, until then only India. There is some sales coming in solicitor qualification exam from neighborhood countries - from Gulf and all of that in our UK entity but we have not actively pursued it yet but might do so.

items.statement: No significant seasonality except festival season ad cost impact; sales team and boot camps can overcome seasonality
items.quote: I think we have seen October, November, December being off several cases in some of the years. But it is not much and it can be overcome if our sales growth and boot camp growth is strong then that will not matter and if we are really good at our ads and everything it should not affect too much.

items.statement: AI calls receive complaints but boot camp attendance doubled or increased 50-70%; AI must be used judiciously
items.quote: So yes, we receive complaints that there are AI calls, but we also have seen our boot camp attendance double or increase by 50%, 70% so we know that it works but it has to be worked judiciously it has to be used judiciously and not overused so that's that's what I think.

items.statement: Cell line production to start around 15th September; first invoice expected 19th-20th September
items.quote: we are going to commence the production of our solar cells TOPCon G12R third generation around 15th of September. And we are very happy to share with you all that with all the prob ability we shall first invoice of our solar cells will happen around 19th or 20th of September with all the probabilities

items.statement: Full-year FY28 revenue guidance of Rs 4,000 crore at full 2.2 GW cell capacity
items.quote: Next year we will have full capacity of 2.2 gigawatt of solar cells. So, assuming that the 1 gigawatt fetches you Rs. 2,000 crore, Rs. 2,200 crore, so we should be able to do Rs. 4,000 crore easily in the next full financial year.

items.statement: Cell business EBITDA margins 35-40%, PAT margins 20-25%; expect to maintain for at least one year
items.quote: So, the cell business nowadays commands an EBITDA of around 35% to 40% and PAT of 20% to 25%. And there is still ample demand in the market and we don't see these margins going down substantially. And we hope to maintain at least for one year this kind of EBITDA or the PAT margins

items.statement: 2.2 GW TOPCon cell line capex ~Rs 890 crore
items.quote: Yes, it is in the public domain also. So, we spent almost Rs. 890 CR and so that is the numbers which is there.

items.statement: Total debt on cell line ~Rs 341 crore; peak not expected to exceed Rs 350-360 crore
items.quote: as of now our total debt is on this is just Rs. 341 odd crores because w e are still spending some money. So, it won't be more than Rs. 350 odd crores or maybe Rs. 360 odd crores the debt component on this cell line, cell business

items.statement: No plan to raise equity now; will consider after visibility from cell operations
items.quote: Going by our innovative funding of the solar cell line, we will deploy the similar strategy wherein very small debt will be taken on the books. And at the same time, our plan to raise more equity or funds from the market will be taken around when we have some more visibility from our cell operations. So, as of now, there is no plan to sell more equity in the market.

items.statement: Aluminum frame capacity expanding from 12,000 to 18,000 tons per annum
items.quote: Yes, we are producing aluminum frame in the facility, and we are likely to expand the capacity to 18,000 tons per annum.

items.statement: Module capacity upgrade of 300-400 MW underway by replacing old machines
items.quote: by removing one old machine and the input with the most recent machine, we should be able to increase the capacity of our plant by another 300 to 400 megawatt. And this is an ongoing process which keeps on happening.

items.statement: Wafer and ingot manufacturing (2.5 GW) targeted operational by ALMM List-III enforcement (June 2028)
items.quote: our part production should be ready when this ALWM, which is ALMM List -III will be enforced. So, our manufacturing of 2.5 gigawatt should be operational by that time

items.statement: India annual solar panel demand ~65-70 GW growing 8-9% annually; green hydrogen and data center demand additional
items.quote: India needs almost 65 to 70 gigawatt of solar panels annually and which is again expanding around at the rate of around 8% to 9%. And some gentlemen asked me a question on green hydrogen and data centers. So, this is additional demand.

items.statement: KUSUM scheme: FY26 revenue Rs 223 crore; FY27 target Rs 500 crore; Rs 350 crore orders already received
items.quote: Sir, last year we did Rs. 223 crores and this year we had a target of Rs. 500 crores. We have already received orders of Rs. 350 crores, which we are executing and as soon as these tenders open, we hope to surpass that also.

items.statement: Cell manufacturing cost competitive with China if India electricity and interest rates matched; raw material costs have inbuilt issues
items.quote: Our analysis or our guidance in the cost of manufacturing tells us that we are more or less competitive to vis -a-vis with China also. Only problem in India is that our raw material costs they have certain inbuilt issues. Our rate of interest is quite high, and our electricity cost is also very high.

items.statement: Q1 FY27: Revenue Rs 500 crore, EBITDA ~Rs 80 crore (15.5% margin), PAT Rs 40 crore (8% margin)
items.quote: this past quarter we closed strong at Rs. 500 crores revenue with an EBITDA of almost Rs. 80 crores and a PAT of Rs. 40 crores. We sustained EBITDA and PAT margins of 15.5% and 8% respectively.

items.statement: Fire incident at cell plant caused ~1 month delay; damaged critical areas but inauguration planned 10th-11th September
items.quote: Unfortunately, because of this fire incident, which was not a very large fire, but still it damaged some critical areas of the plant. And so that is why we have a delay of almost a month because of that.

items.statement: Cell line depreciation planned over 5 years; cash EBITDA could cover capex in 1.5-2 years
items.quote: Our plan is to take the depreciation within five years. Let me give you a very simple calculation. The cell business is as everybody knows, the EBITDA margins are around 35% to 40% depending on the manufacturer. And with that EBITDA, we should be able to depreciate the whole plant within next 1.5 year or maximum 2 years. But we are going to depreciate in 5 years.

items.statement: Cannot export modules to USA; must compete with China in unprotected international markets
items.quote: you cannot export to USA. And all in other markets you have to compete with China and the China is really, really aggressive. On standalone basis, you cannot compete with China in the international market where there is no protection.

items.statement: Management expects >50% top-line growth for next three years on standalone diagnostic business
items.quote: The way we are expanding our business, I'm expecting more than 50% year-to-year growth for next three years at the moment.

items.statement: Management targets 40% EBITDA margin at company level within few months
items.quote: 40% EBITDA very soon. Because Rajiv, at the moment how much diagnostic EBITDA at the moment? It is more than 36%. It is already 36%. We will reach 40% very soon. Maybe in few months.

items.statement: Additional ~INR10 crore capex planned this year for 8 comprehensive centers, labs, 2 PET scans, genome lab; funded from internal accruals or debt
items.quote: And that will be from our internal accrual, and if we require anything, we can go for debt also. We don't have any reservation and we can go for debt also if we need. But we will complete all the expansion plan for this year, and which has eight comprehensive centers and more than five-six labs, and we are going to have two PET scans and one genome lab, that is all -- we will complete all the expa

items.statement: Network expanded to 327 centers (264 franchise, 23 comprehensive, 18 diagnostic, 24 standalone labs, 15 radiology); franchise at 375 as of call date
items.quote: With these additions, our overall network has already reached 327 centers, and that includes franchise centers also. Our franchise network continues to scale well, enabling us to extend our reach in capital-efficient manner.

items.statement: Targets 1,000 franchise centers in FY27 and 3,000 in next 2 years; 134 franchise added in Q1, >100 per month recently
items.quote: We have set a very clear target to scale up to 1,000 franchise in this financial year and 3,000 franchise in next 2 years.

items.statement: 8 comprehensive diagnostic centers to be operational in next 3-4 months; 2 PET scans at Kanpur and Gorakhpur in 2-3 months; genome lab at Lucknow in 6 months
items.quote: We are already working on 8 comprehensive diagnostic centers in this year, which will start in next 3 to 4 months. They are nearly complete, and one by one we will start, and in next 3 to 4 months all the 8 comprehensive diagnostic centers will be operational. Together with comprehensive diagnostic centers, we are in process to open more than 6 diagnostic centers. These centers will have lab and r

items.statement: Government projects: 8 of 12 radiology centers in Punjab secured, to start in 2-3 months; Guwahati center starting radiology services this month, full in 3 months; all govt projects to be operational this FY
items.quote: We have secured eight of the twelve spaces in Punjab. So, we've secured these eight spaces, and we'll have all our centers operational within the next two to three months. And the Guwahati center, that will also -- we are going to start few radiological services in this month, and rest of the services we will start in next three months. So, Guwahati project will be completed in next three months a

items.statement: Q1 FY27: B2B revenue +94% YoY, B2G +22%, B2C +20%; patient volumes: general/online +29%, corporate +24%, government +14%; preventive health checkups +29%
items.quote: Our B2B business has grown by 94% year-on-year. Government, that is B2G business, that has grown by 22%, and B2C, it is comprising of referrals from the doctors and online business, and it has grown by 20%. Patient volumes also continued to expand. General referral and online patient volumes grew by 29% year-on-year. Corporate volumes increased by 24%, while government patient volumes grew by 14%.

items.statement: Consolidated Q1 FY27: Revenue INR82.26 cr (+19.6% YoY), EBITDA INR20.98 cr (+42.3%), EBITDA margin 25.51% (+46 bps); PAT INR7.5 cr (+29%), PAT margin 9.11% (+17 bps)
items.quote: So, this quarter we have registered a sales of INR82.26 crores, consolidated sales of INR82.26 crores, with a growth of 19.62% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at INR20.98 crores this quarter, with a growth of 42.27%, and this EBITDA has registered upside of 4.6 basis point with a margin of 25.51%.

items.statement: Standalone diagnostics Q1 FY27: Revenue INR49.75 cr (+35.9% YoY), EBITDA INR18.19 cr (+47.4%), EBITDA margin 36.57% (+285 bps); PAT INR6.7 cr, PAT margin 13.48%
items.quote: In standalone diagnostics, we have done top-line revenue of INR49.75 crores, and this is a 35.85% growth as compared to last year. EBITDA of standalone diagnostics stood at INR18.19 crores, with a growth of 47.36% as compared to last year. EBITDA margin was 36.57% with a growth of 285 basis point.

items.statement: Standalone revenue mix: B2C 38%, B2B 32%, B2G 30%; pathology 74%, radiology 25.86%; management aims for ~1/3 each across B2C/B2B/B2G
items.quote: In standalone, the contribution of segment was -- B2C was 38% out of total sales, B2B was 32%, and B2G was 30%. If I talk about vertical-wise, pathology did 74% out of total sales, and rest 25.86% was done by radiology.

items.statement: Radiology share may rise when government radiology contracts materialize; focus on growing B2C for cash collections
items.quote: But still, we are concentrating more on B2C segment, so that cash business should raise. That is the our main aim. Whether it is radiology or pathology, but the mix may be 75-25 and it may be different from here on, but we will concentrate more on B2C market and B2B market rather than B2G.

items.statement: B2G receivables average ~4 months (range 2-6 months); B2B receivables 1-2 months; no bad debts in B2G or B2B
items.quote: In case of B2G, few contracts have only one to two months and most of the time it is four months on an average B2G. And B2B is one to two months. B2G normally if you see the average, sometimes we get all the payment and two months receivable remains and sometimes we get the payment after six months.

items.statement: Divested 53.56% stake in Chandan Pharmacy for ~INR16.77 cr on 1 Sep; proceeds to fund diagnostic expansion; pharmacy was low-margin trading business
items.quote: More recently, in August, we announced the divestment of our entire 53.56% shareholding in Chandan Pharmacy Limited for a consideration of approximately INR16.77 crores. And this transaction is aligned with our strategy of sharpening our focus on the higher margin diagnostic business.

items.statement: Jeena Sikho partnership: ~80% of their centers covered, generating ~INR1.45 cr/month and growing; exclusive pathology partnership for new hospitals/clinics
items.quote: We are getting samples we are getting samples from their hospital in clinics. Nearly 80.00% centers we have already covered and rest of the 20.00% will be covered in next few months. And wherever they will open any hospital and clinic, this is our association and exclusive partnership and we will definitely put our lab inside the hospital and doing all the pathological job. So, it is continuing in

items.statement: Franchise model targets phlebotomists; zero capex for company; franchisee invests ~INR1 lakh, pays INR25k-1L advance; company shares 50-80% of MRP (avg ~65% margin to company)
items.quote: Most of the time, I tell you, these are the phlebotomists. items.statement: New international orders worth INR 105 crores won FY27 year-to-date, representing 25% of FY26 reported revenue
items.quote: We have also won new international orders worth INR 105 crores FY27 year-to-date from leading streaming platforms, 25% of those FY26 reported revenue, giving strong FY27 revenue visibility.

items.statement: Active bid pipeline stands at INR 700 crores with 40% at advanced stage of conversion
items.quote: Our active bid pipeline stands at INR 700 crores, with 40% at an advanced stage of conversion.

items.statement: Undelivered order book of INR 250-260 crores to be executed within FY27, including new wins
items.quote: So, to answer that, including the new winning of INR 105 crores called out for the current financial year, we sit around the range of INR 250 crores to INR 260 crores out of the order book undelivered as we speak and to be delivered within the FY27.

items.statement: Expect to cross last year's revenue of INR 418 crores comfortably with significant growth, targeting historical 30%+ top-line growth trend to continue or surpass
items.quote: Yes, I will refrain to calling out any number for the future perspective. But yes, as I said that we should cross the last year number comfortably and we expect a significant we expect a good growth on those numbers.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin declined 584 bps YoY to 13.91% due to unrealized forex loss, higher management travel, overlapping work migration costs, and increased IT expenses
items.quote: EBITDA margins at 13.91%, a decline of 584 bps year-on-year. Decline in EBITDA and EBITDA margins are primarily due to the unrealized FOREX loss, higher management travel, overlapping work migration costs, and increased IT expenses.

items.statement: Normalized PAT margin remains in 14-15% range after excluding one-offs like severance costs, forex losses, and depreciation from tech investments
items.quote: If we take out this all, our PAT percentage is still at the same percentage of the 14% or the 15% range what we had it earlier. So, it's a timing gap more.

items.statement: Bengaluru physical facility planned to be operational from October with 150 seats for high-end work, adding 80-100 employees immediately
items.quote: we are also planning up a physical facility to be in Bengaluru from operationally from October, where we are looking at 150 seat for of India B engaluru for more high-end

items.statement: Project Hybrid rollout targeted for end of August, USD pipeline integration by September for seamless global studio interoperability
items.quote: The Project Hybrid, as we call it, and the USD pipeline integration are both in the pre-rollout testing phase with Project Hybrid on track to be rolled out at the end of August and the USD pipeline integration by September, enabling seamless interoperability across the global studios.

items.statement: Migrated 30-40 high-end roles from UK/Europe to India in last two quarters; full offshoring initiatives to complete by end of FY27 (March 2027)
items.quote: So, if we talk about last two quarters, we have already migrated close to 30 to 40 high-end roles, and we have a huge expansion plan in Bengaluru. So, all to materialize, it should be all done by the end of the FY27, by March '27.

items.statement: No debt planned for potential acquisition; will fund majority stake purchase from cash on books (INR 37 crores QIP + INR 21 crores IPO unutilized in FDs)
items.quote: No, not at this point of the time. So, I think we have the appetite to go largely for the cost of acquisition with the funds in hand.

items.statement: Evaluating two M&A targets at advanced stage: one profitable commercial VFX company with flexible cost model, another with attractive valuation but lower profitability; target is North American company
items.quote: So, to be honest with you, by now we have evaluated a large number of the M&A deal and in fact, the travel I mentioned that was also relating to that management travel for that. We are at an advanced stage.

items.statement: Domestic OTT sales revenue already crossed 2x of full year FY26 revenue from this segment after onboarding Netflix and Amazon for full-length domestic OTT mandates
items.quote: We also achieved a breakthrough in the domestic streaming market as well, onboarding both Netflix and Amazon for full-length domestic OTT mandates, and domestic OTT sales revenue has already crossed 2x of our full year FY26 revenue from this segment.

items.statement: Delivered 89 projects (28 movies, 53 series, 8 commercials) for 60 clients globally including 10 new clients in Q1 FY27
items.quote: During the quarter, we delivered 89 projects, 28 movies, 53 series, and 8 commercials for 60 clients globally, including 10 new clients.

items.statement: Collections from March to June were almost 2x normal run rate; some payments scheduled for July now expected in August
items.quote: If I can give you the sense, our collection for the March to June was almost 2x of the collection used to be in the normal. So, we got some good collection.

items.statement: Key hires include Ajit Nair (CG Supervisor), Venugopal (2D Supervisor), Stuart Lashley and Sebastian Gourday (VFX Supervisors), Ameya Samant (Senior Business Development Manager)
items.quote: We have also got in Ameya Samant as the Senior Business Development Manager, leading strategic sales and market expansion domestically.

items.statement: INR 37 crores QIP proceeds and INR 21 crores IPO proceeds remain unutilized, largely parked in fixed deposits
items.quote: So, we do have about INR 37 crores of the QIP unutilized and close to INR 21 crores of the IPO unutilized. And that remains large part into the fixed deposits.

items.statement: Severance costs of INR 2.9 crores in Q1 FY27 vs INR 3.2 crores for full FY26; management expects no further margin deterioration as H2 revenue heavier and offshoring benefits to materialize
items.quote: So, we have incurred a INR 2.9 crores, which is reflecting in financial as an exceptional item, versus INR 3.2 crores for the full year. We can take this slowly, but that case the profit comes gradually. We have taken that entire hit in a quarter so that the profitability can be can be delivered in a more faster way.

items.statement: PM Modi's Independence Day address highlighted VFX, animation, gaming, digital content as key to India's soft power, providing policy endorsement for sector
items.quote: Our Honorable Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Independence Day address on 15 August 2026 highlighted VFX animation, gaming, and digital content as key to India's soft power, a strong policy endorsement that reinforces the sector's strategic importance.

items.statement: Unrealized forex loss driven by higher March rates vs current quarter, particularly Canadian currency; not a real loss but accounting revaluation
items.quote: A large part of these INR 4.2 crores are coming from the unrealized forex, because we have the debtors and some outstanding as you know, and the rates were particularly higher by the March versus compared to this quarter, particularly the Canadian currency.

items.statement: Transitioning from VFX vendor competing on bids to creative partner collaborating with filmmakers from early production stages; developed high-end creative presentation for upcoming Apple show
items.quote: We are also evolving from a VFX vendor competing on bids to a creative partner collaborating directly with filmmakers from early production stages. Last quarter, we developed a high-end creative presentation for an upcoming Apple show with VFX production starting in October.

items.statement: Integrated Comfy UI into proprietary pipeline for de-aging, age conditioning, asset creation, and 4K texture creation; completed transition to owned NetApp infrastructure replacing cloud dependence
items.quote: This quarter, we integrated the Comfy UI into the new pipeline for our proprietary tool sets like the de-aging, age conditioning, asset creation, and also the 4K texture creation as well. We also completed our transition to owned NetApp infrastructure, replacing cloud dependence while improving scalability and control.

items.statement: Won major bid of 4-4.5 million USD vs normal ticket size of 1-1.5 million USD; several advanced-stage bids in 4-5 million USD range
items.quote: Our normal bidding ticket size used to be 1 million to 1.5 million and the winning I am talking about that is in the range of 4 million to 4.5 million. So, we are now currently bidding to a hybrid value.

items.statement: Middle East emerging as strategic VFX hub with Saudi Arabia, Abu Dhabi, Qatar investing in entertainment assets and creative technology; Abu Dhabi invested US$200M in DNEG at US$2B+ valuation
items.quote: The Middle East is emerging as a strategic hub for global entertainment, with Saudi Arabia, Abu Dhabi, and Qatar investing directly in entertainment assets and creative technology companies, notably Abu Dhabi's US$200 million investment in DNEG, valuing it at more than US$2 billion.

items.statement: Q3 and Q4 expected to be best quarters for FY27 due to Christmas seasonality, delivery schedule of order book, and bidding pipeline conversion
items.quote: We expect, to be honest, that Q3, Q4 will be the best quarter for us in the financial year.

items.statement: Standalone India EBITDA margin stable at 42% YoY; consolidated margin pressure from One of Us acquisition integration and offshoring transition costs
items.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 42%, remaining stable compared to the same quarter last year.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 6-6.5%
items.quote: As far as the EBITDA guidance is concerned, curren tly Q1 we are impacted on the profitability. We are giving a guidance of around 6 to 6.5 percent for the whole of the year this year

items.statement: Strong demand across refrigeration and cold chain segments; newer categories chest freezers and continuous panels gaining excellent market acceptance
items.quote: Growth was supported by healthy demand across refrigeration and cold chain segments. With newer categories such as chest freezers and continuous panels gaining excellent market acceptance.

items.statement: Order book at Rs 222 crore with breakdown across segments
items.quote: Yes. Our total pending order book is Rs 222 crore, cold room is Rs 39 crore, commercial refrigeration is Rs. 29 crore, Industrial refrigeration Rs 5 crore, transport refrigeration is Rs. Four crore ammonia refrigeration is Rs. 87 crores, project is Rs 45 crore, commercial freezers (as per dealers estimate) and Continuous panel is Rs 11 crore.

items.quote: Our proposed Galilei transaction, Rs. 180 crores investment is pr oposed through a preferential issue with an additional Rs. 10 crores proposed to be raised from other investors. The funds are intended for capacity expansion and modernization. The proposed JV, completion of corporate office and center of excellence, development and testing laboratory, repayment of certain borrowing and selective i

items.statement: Existing capacity can support Rs 950 crore+ revenue after first phase; new verticals at 60% utilisation in Q1
items.quote: After the first phase of capacity building, we can expect Rs 950 crore plus top line contribution. It is our installed capacity.

items.statement: Price hikes of ~11% implemented but industry impact 15-18%; 6-6.5% price rise not yet passed on; expect pass-through from H2 FY27
items.quote: Actually, what we have told was a price hike of around 11% but the overall impact from industry was Somewhere around 15 to 18%. Sti ll, we lack somewhere around 6 to 6.5 percent price rise we have not passed on

items.statement: Indirect import component 22-25% of total purchase; Rs 50 lakh forex loss booked; raw material volatility expected to continue through Q2 and into Q3
items.quote: Further to dollar increases impact, we have indirect import component of around 22-25 %, the total purchase composition that consists of importing indirect material, indirect import as well. So, their (Peers) import impact is also high, somewhere around fifty lakhs foreign exchange fluctuation loss we have booked.

items.statement: Revenue mix: cold room 42%, commercial refrigeration 14%, continuous panel 14%, commercial freezers 12%, ammonia/project 9%, transport 6%, industrial 3%
items.quote: Right. The cold room contributed around 42%. Industrial refrigeration is around 3%. commercial refrigeration 14%, transport refrigeration 6%, ammonia and project around 9%, Continuous panel around 14% and commercial freezers around 12%.

items.statement: Focus on dealer/retail market over sponsored market for better margins; chest freezer and continuous panel businesses grown significantly
items.quote: And if you talk about the margins case, margin is lying in the retail mark et and not in the sponsored market. So, our first focus will be strongly dealer market and retail market where we want to establish our brand on the dealer channel and not on the name of any coke and

items.quote: In our JV product manufacturing segment, we have only one company and for a second player the gap is big and market is big, right now the market demand is catered by the unorganized players and supply from China

items.statement: Rs 40 crore debt repayment from Galilei proceeds; Rs 39 crore for working capital needs previously used for capex
items.quote: Rs. 40 crore repayment of debt is there in our preferential object and the other, Rs. 39 Crore is as a GCP is mostly towards the working capital need so, that is exactly where we are planning to pay the debt which is earlier used for the capex purpose.

items.statement: Preferential issue of Rs 180 crore from Galilei Holdings (60% JV stake) plus Rs 10 crore from other investors; Ice Make holds 40% in JV
items.quote: The proposed 60:40 joint venture with Galilei holding 60% and Ice Make holding forty will initially focus on commercial refrigerati on products such as the commercial upright and table

items.quote: Further there are some acquisition-related opportunities as well which are under discussion. We are still exploring it, so, we cannot comment exactly on the status. But once the things are finalized we will update you at the right time.

items.statement: Addressable market for Galilei JV products (commercial upright/table refrigerators) estimated at Rs 1,200-1,500 crore
items.quote: With our discussion with team, I believe the addressable market size could be around Rs 1200-1500 crore right now.

items.statement: Raw material price volatility expected to continue through Q2 and into Q3 due to global uncertainty and war impact; no stabilisation expected
items.quote: We expect that the situation of volatility will continue over the ne xt quarter. I mean this Q2 and So, me rub off on the Q3 as well. So, we do not see any hope that the raw material will become stabilized or the volatility will come down

items.statement: Depreciation policy changed from WDV to align capex benefits with future revenue; competitors use similar policy
items.quote: The company undertaking heavy capex in upcoming times, so, benefit of this capex going forward will gradually show in our busine ss, whereas previous WDV policy of maximum depreciation, initially So, we felt that the benefit which company is going to get from the investment doesn't sync with the existing policy we have ad opted so, suitably to match the benefit with the cost on our books we have d

items.statement: Old order book of ~Rs 70-75 crore (ex-projects) executed at pre-hike prices in Q1; ~Rs 100 crore project orders at old prices with 50% executed
items.quote: Ok, if you remove the projects pipeline, so, cold room, commercial, and PUF panel that would be around 70-75 crore, so, you can consider that it was booked at old prices and can have a hit on margins.

items.statement: Galilei JV initially targeting Indian market only; export opportunities not pursued in first phase
items.quote: In the first phase we are targeting in Indian Market.

items.statement: Galilei JV production targeted by February 2028 (18-month roadmap); product design for Indian conditions, power and environmental rules
items.quote: We have targeted production by February 2028. Our partner has given us a roadmap of 18 months. We need to design the set up an d design the product keeping mind the Indian conditions, power and environmental rules, the pr oduct design and technology will come from them

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of INR 1,600 crores
items.quote: Encouraged by the strong start to the year and a healthy order pipeline, we remain confident on sustaining this growth trajectory and achieving our FY27 revenue guidance of INR 1,600 crores.

items.statement: Engineering and EPC order book of INR 1,500 crores plus and bidding pipeline of INR 2,400 crores plus
items.quote: This has been supported by INR 1,500 crores plus of order book of INR 2,400 crores plus of orders which are bidding in pipeline.

items.statement: Robust demand across oil and gas, water infrastructure, marine projects, refineries, industrial, construction, fuel farms, and other infrastructure segments
items.quote: The demand remains robust across oil and gas, water infrastructure, marine projects, refineries, industrial, construction, fuel farms, and other infrastructure segments.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 493 bps to 16.3% driven by higher engineering and EPC contribution, better mix, operating efficiencies, increased utilization, and disciplined cost management
items.quote: The EBITDA increased by 74.8% year -on-year to INR 49.2 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded by 493 basis points to 16.3%.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 16% to 18%
items.quote: So, we are looking at around 16% to 18% of EBITDA?

items.statement: Defense manufacturing first phase investment of INR 550 crores with debt of INR 200-250 crores; second phase INR 400-450 crores
items.quote: We intend to grow this defense on the initial first 2-3 years at a INR 1,000 crore basis, okay? The first set of investment would be around INR 550 crores and second would be around 400-INR 450 crores, that would be.

items.quote: So, current debt is around INR 400 crores at consolidated level, outstanding. Because we have solar also, so it is also funded by debt, partially. Yes.

items.statement: Vasai facility capacity utilization at 35-40% currently, targeting 65-70% by end of FY27, peak utilization in 1.5-2 years
items.quote: What you mean is the Vasai facility at the moment, we are looking at around 35 %-40% of capacity utilization. And we by the year end of FY, we look at around 65%-70% of capacity.

items.statement: Engineering and EPC revenue mix increased to 99:1 vs textiles in Q1 FY27 from 44:56 in Q1 FY26
items.quote: The contribution of Engineering and EPC to the overall revenue mix increased significantly to a ratio of 99:1 against Textiles in the Q1 FY27, compared to the ratio of 44:56 in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: Solar business revenue contribution of INR 50-60 crores in FY27, peaking at INR 80-90 crores in FY28 with 25-year PPA and 15-16% IRR
items.quote: So, in current year, what we are looking at around INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores of revenue contribution coming in this year. And at peak level, what will be the contribution? Around INR 80 crores to INR 90 crores.

items.statement: Defense ammunition revenue target of INR 70-100 crores in Q4 FY27, INR 300-350 crores in FY28 with 45-50% EBITDA margin and 30-35% PAT margin
items.quote: Around INR 300 crores to INR 350 crores.

items.statement: Aerospace JV revenue target of INR 100 crores in first calendar year with 45-50% EBITDA margin, UAV component manufacturing from Vasai in Q3 FY27
items.quote: With a first calendar year revenue target of around INR 100 crores, the joint venture reflects the significant market potential of the business and growing trust among global customers in the platform, technological, engineering, and manufacturing sector.

items.statement: Working capital days at 90 currently, targeting improvement to 80-90 days
items.quote: So, we are looking at around 90 days of working capital at the moment and we look forward to get more efficient to between 80 to 90 in the coming days and that is how our plan is.

items.statement: Received ammunition manufacturing license for subsidiary Tembo Classic Engineering Pvt. Ltd. in Q1 FY27
items.quote: A landmark achievement was the receipt of the ammunition manufacturing lic ense to our subsidiary Tembo Classic Engineering Pvt. Ltd. in Q1 of FY27.

items.statement: Strategic international JV with JR UAV Europe Italy and JR PROPO Japan for advanced UAV technologies via JR UAV Limited
items.quote: In the aerospace, we announced a strategic international joint venture agreement with JR UAV Europe Italy and JR PROPO Japan to our company JR UAV Limited, aiming at bringing advanced UAV technologies to India.

items.statement: Fundraise decision is strategic and will be notified to exchange when required; no immediate fundraise confirmed
items.quote: So, as of now, this is a strategic decision which will come in place only after a management discussion. And as and when required, we would notify the exchange accordingly.

items.statement: Targets consolidated revenue of Rs. 750 crores and EBITDA of Rs. 113 crores for FY27
items.quote: So next, this current year, we are targeting a consolidated revenue of about Rs. 750 crores with an EBITDA of Rs. 113 crores, which is pretty much in line with what we have done till now.

items.statement: Targets Rs. 1,100 crore top line by FY28 and PAT in excess of Rs. 100 crores
items.quote: We have a clear vision targeting a Rs. 1,100 crore top line by FY '28 and a PAT in excess of Rs. 100 crores.

items.statement: Targets Rs. 1,000 crore revenue with 8-9% PAT margin over next few years
items.quote: we are targeting a revenue in excess of Rs. 1,000 crore and with a PAT margin of roughly 8% to 9%.

items.statement: Plans integrated facility in Siliguri on 30 acres with project cost of Rs. 450-500 crores over 3-5 years
items.quote: The land and site development would cost us roughly around Rs. 70 crores. And the project cost would be in the range of Rs. 450 crores to Rs. 500 crores.

items.statement: Requires Rs. 5-7 crores CapEx to scale up chocolate facility at Madhur through internal accruals
items.quote: Not more than Rs. 5 crores - Rs. 7 crores. Plus existing infrastructure, we have ample amount of space to put all the new machinery, which we would require to scale up the production.

items.statement: Current capacity utilization at 45% with potential to double revenue from existing facilities
items.quote: we are about 45% capacity utilization. And we have the potential to, with the same facilities itself, we can potentially do twice the revenue that we are doing right now.

items.statement: Asansol and Siliguri facilities at 100% double shift; adding third shift operations
items.quote: Asansol and Siliguri are occupied 100% on a double shift basis. We are going to start third shift operations.

items.statement: Madhur Confectionery targets Rs. 150 crores revenue in FY27 and Rs. 250-300 crores in 2-3 years
items.quote: this year we are at a comfortable pace to reach a number close to Rs. 150 crores.

items.statement: Andri Agro targets Rs. 60-70 crores revenue in FY27 and doubling over next two years
items.quote: We hope to generate a revenue of about Rs. 60 crores to Rs. 70 crores this year and double the revenue over the next two years in Andri Agro.

items.statement: OFFSIDE brand generating Rs. 2 crores monthly revenue, targeting Rs. 5-10 crores monthly within a year
items.quote: We have already started generating a revenue of Rs. 2 crores per month from OFFSIDE products itself. This is going to go up to about, in the range of anywhere between Rs. 5 crores to Rs. 10 crores we should be doing over the next year or so.

items.statement: EBITDA margins improved from 8.5% to 14% blended due to Madhur acquisition
items.quote: EBITDA margins have grown from 8.5% to 14% blended, mostly due to the benefit of having Madhur with us which is a high margin product category.

items.statement: Targets Rs. 100 crores EBITDA and Rs. 30 crores PAT over next year or two
items.quote: We are targeting an EBITDA of Rs. 100 crores over the next, maybe next year or the year after that, and a PAT of Rs. 30 crores.

items.statement: Focusing on Rs. 10-15 price segment for premiumization and margin improvement amid rising raw material costs
items.quote: with the increasing raw material prices, the way forward happens to be catering to the segment that is between Rs. 10 and Rs. 15.

items.statement: Distributor credit days to reduce from 90 to 60 days by end of FY27, then to 30 days over next 2 years
items.quote: It should be in the range of 60 days by end of '27.

items.statement: Expects positive operating cash flow by end of FY27
items.quote: This financial year end, we should have a positive operating cash flow for sure given the steps that we have taken in order to address that.

items.statement: Current debt at Rs. 180 crores; plans to repay using internal accruals
items.quote: the current debt in the company stands at about Rs.180 crores.

items.statement: Madhur acquisition funded by Rs. 140 crores equity via QIP and Rs. 40 crores debt
items.quote: Rs. 140 crores was equity. The balance Rs. 40 crores was debt.

items.statement: Siliguri CapEx to start with internal accruals; may consider debentures or QIP later
items.quote: So, we will start with internal accruals for now. And maybe going forward, if required, we can consider doing a debenture issue or we can look at other modes of financing the CapEx through a QIP placement in future.

items.statement: Promoter pledge reduced from 86% to 70%; targets zero pledge by September end
items.quote: we have already brought down the pledge from a peak of 86% to now 70%. And the unpledging process would take another couple of months. So, hopefully by the half year ending, we should have zero pledge in Annapurna.

items.statement: Board strengthened with independent directors from Nestle, Britannia, Unilever
items.quote: Mr. Chandan Ghosh is the independent director, ex-Nestle. Ms. Rachna Yadav is a senior HR executive. Mr. Harish is an ex-Britannia, Unilever, a senior executive.

items.statement: Portfolio expanded from 6 to 13 categories, 188 SKUs; fryums, namkeen, biscuits, cakes, sweets, noodles, confectionery
items.quote: Our product categories have grown from 6 to 13. We have about 180 SKUs right now with 250 stockists and 1,150 distributors.

items.statement: Reaches 8.5 lakh retail outlets across 15 states via 1,150 distributors and 250 stockists
items.quote: We are reaching a retail touchpoint of 8.5 lakh retail outlets with presence across 15 states but mostly concentrated in Eastern India with 33 lakh packets being sold every day.

items.statement: Targets disrupting local manufacturers with better quality at reasonable prices, not competing directly with ITC or national brands
items.quote: We are not competing with ITC. ITC is a completely different scale. I mean, what we are trying to basically do is disrupt the local manufacturers.

items.statement: Seeking government support for land acquisition in West Bengal; discussions with MSME ministry underway
items.quote: Now with the new government, maybe we will get support in the land acquisition process as well. And we are in discussions with the MSME ministry over here.

items.statement: Plans to explore export markets in a big way leveraging confectionery portfolio logistics advantage
items.quote: And we are looking at a multi-channel growth acceleration. So, we will be entering modern trade, general trade and also export markets are going to be explored in a big way right now.

items.statement: Sells approximately 3.3 million packets daily across distribution network
items.quote: We are selling approximately 3.3 million packets a day.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth target of 15-20%
items.quote: As we said in our previous earning call, our objective for '27 is to deliver approximately 15% to 20% growth. We remain confident in this objective, supported by our existing customer base, new customer pipeline, and expansion into a new business segment.

items.statement: FY27 growth split: 7-8% from new business, 8-10% from existing customers
items.quote: So, around 7% to 8% growth will come with the new business and around 8%-10% growth will come through existing customers through new contract, expansion of our business.

items.statement: Haldiram contract for 100 dedicated vehicles; 40 deployed, 60 in progress; potential additional 100 by Dec 2026
items.quote: We have secured a long-term contract from Haldiram, Nagpur for the deployment of 100 dedicated vehicles. This is an important addition to our FMCG business and strengthen our presence across western, southern and key eastern market including Odisha, Bihar and Jharkhand.

items.quote: We invested INR62 crores in FY '26 and targeting INR50 crores plus in capex in current financial year FY '27 with additional fleet requirements fulfilling through the operational lease of the vehicle, particularly in EV segment due to heavy capex requirement.

items.statement: FY27 fleet addition target ~200 vehicles via purchase and lease (CNG 50-60, LNG 100, EV 30-100)
items.quote: So around CNG, around 50-60 vehicle, LNG, we got the contract of 100 vehicles and electric, as of now we got the order of 30 vehicles, but our 70 vehicle order is discussion is going on. So total target is to add around 200 vehicle in this March '27.

items.statement: PBT margin up 98 bps to 6.58%, PAT margin up 89 bps to 4.87% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: PBT margin improved by 98 basis points to 6.58% and PAT margin improved by 89 basis points to 4.87%.

items.statement: Expect further margin improvement in FY27 from asset sweating, better utilization, backloading, and green fleet lower operating cost
items.quote: We expect our margins to improve as the benefit of the capex done during 25-26 start coming from this current year of '27. A major part of capex was done in second half of '26, '25-26. Therefore, these new asset vehicles, asset will higher contribution and higher utilization in '27, as they will be operational for the entire financial year.

items.statement: Higher margins in dedicated vehicles, cold chain, reefer, warehousing, factory management, liquid logistics, EV, LNG
items.quote: Basically – currently, we are -- generally see better margin in dedicated vehicles, cold chain business, reefer trucks and warehousing and factory management. Now-a-days, we are doing business of customer warehouse operations. So these are specialized segment where competition is less and since the vehicles are dedicated to specific customer requirement, we are able to achieve better utilization a

items.statement: Significant portion of contracts have fuel escalation clauses to manage fuel price impact
items.quote: Fuel is an important cost for our industry. However, a significant portion of our customer contracts have fuel escalation clauses which help us manage the impact of change in fuel prices.

items.statement: Pan-India network: 3,000+ owned/hired vehicles, 70+ branches, 7.4 lakh sq ft warehousing
items.quote: We have built a pan-India network, a diversified customer base, more than 3,000 owned and hired vehicles, over 70 branches, and more than 7.4 lakh square feet of warehousing capacity.

items.statement: Liquid logistics: 2 tanker trains purchased, future additions via lease; JV Carbonlite Logistics to start ops Oct 1
items.quote: Two set of tankers we have already purchased and now further purchase, we are don't want to take our books. We want to take the future few tankers or two trains from leasing basis only. items.statement: Focus on deepening wallet share with existing customers; Haldiram, Baidyanath JV for green logistics
items.quote: We are not only looking at growth through new customer, we are also working closely with our existing customers to identify additional requirements across geographies and business segments. This allow us to increase wallet share while leveraging the network and infrastructure we already have.

items.statement: Operating on Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC)
items.quote: Recently, government has also started the DFC, Dedicated Freight Corridor where the operation has already started by us through Dedicated Freight Corridor organization.

items.statement: Raised INR 52.93 crores via rights issue for working capital and general corporate purposes
items.quote: During Q1, we raised INR52.93 crores through the rights issue. This provides additional resource for working capital and general corporate purpose, and give us greater flexibility to support our expansion plan and customers' requirement.

items.statement: Net debt ~INR 173 crores, debt/equity 0.67x, current ratio ~1.97x as of Mar 2026; strengthened post rights issue
items.quote: As of March '26, net debt was approximately INR173 crores, debt equity stood at 0.67 times, and the current ratio was approximately 1.97 times. With the rights issue, we have further strengthened our financial position as we go into the next phase of our growth.

items.statement: Dividend declared INR 1.20 per share for FY26; record date Sep 18, 2026
items.quote: The board has declared a dividend of Rupee1.20 per equity share for FY '26, subject to shareholders' approval at the 17th Annual General Meeting. The record date for determining eligibility for the dividend is September 18, 2026.

items.statement: JV Carbonlite Logistics incorporated with Baidyanath Group for green transportation (CNG, LNG, EV)
items.quote: The Baidyanath Group JV, all the formalities has completed. And I hope you must be aware that we have incorporated a company called Carbonlite Logistics Private Limited. With initial capital has been deployed. And I'm talking to the customers long-term contract providing LNG and electric vehicle.

items.statement: Target 15-20% increase in monthly vehicle running km (from 1 lakh to 1.2 lakh km) via technology
items.quote: So for example, if our vehicles are running 1 lakh km in a month, so now we are targeting to make it minimum 15% to 20% growth, 1,20,000, by utilizing the latest software, etcetera.

items.statement: Seasonality: Q1/Q3 normal, Q4 stronger; festive season (Ganesh Chaturthi, Diwali) drives higher demand in H2
items.quote: Generally, Q1 and Q3, normal operating quarters, while four, quarter four usually have better volume. If you see the previous history, quarter four is always better due to higher demand for some of the industries we serve. Therefore, quarterly number should be looked at the manner of full financial year. We expect the higher volume in quarter three and four and overall performance of the year.

items.statement: Government initiatives (PM Gati Shakti, National Logistics Policy, DFC) creating larger opportunity for organized logistics
items.quote: Initiative such as PM Gati Shakti and National Logistics Policy along with the development for freight corridors and logistic infrastructure are creating a much larger opportunity for organized logistic companies.

items.statement: Depreciation to increase due to new asset additions in FY27
items.quote: At the same time, depreciation will increase due to the addition of the new asset. So, depreciation may increase during that time, but overall profit and incremental growth will come in the company.
